427)dbyings mi 'gyur nam mkha'i klong dkyil nas/ /ging dkar dmar gnyis kyis gar 'cham byed/ /rin chen gyi snod du sha chen dang*/ /yid 'ong gi tsho

tei:div.tei:p: 427) dbyings mi 'gyur nam mkha'i klong dkyil nas// ging dkar dmar gnyis kyis gar 'cham byed// rin chen gyi snod du sha chen dang*// yid 'ong gi tshogs rdzas sna tshogs thogs// gdangs snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis glu 'di drangs/ a ho/ snang srid dag pa rab 'byams rnga yab dpal ri yi zhing khams// gzung 'dzin dag pa rab 'byams bla ma rig 'dzin gyi tshom bu// sgra grags dag pa rab 'byams grags stong siddhi yi dbyangs snyan/ dran rtog dag pa rab 'byams 'od gsal chos nyid kyi rol pa// rtsal snang dag pa rab 'byams dpa' bo dpa' mo yi rol gar// 'dod don dag pa rab 'byams tshogs kyi dga' ston la 'du ba'i// gsal stong dag pa rab 'byams byang chub sems sprin gyi mchod pa// rtsol bral dag pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor gyi mnga' bdag /rig stong dag pa rab 'byams tshogs rje tshogs bdag la 'bul lo// zhen bral dag par rab 'byams mnyam nyid chen po ru rol nas// bde stong dag pa rab 'byams mchog gi dngos grub kyang zhu'o/ ma hā su kha siddhi traṃ a la la ho/ zhes gsungs nas 'od thig dkar 428)dmar gyi rnam par mi snang bar gyur to/ zhes pa'ang dus bzang nyer lnga'i nyin nyams snang chal chol du shar ba*/ yid bzhin nor bu'i sku drung du bde ba'i rdo rjes gus phul/ a hoḥ gzhi dbyings ka dag spros bral chos sku yi zhing nas: dag pa gnyis ldan skye med rang byung gi tshom bu: ye grol zhen bral tshogs kyi 'du ba la phebs nas: bdag cag mched lcam dga' ston glu gar la rol bas: nang gsal gzhon nu bum sku'i dngos grub kyang zhu'o: rang gsal lhun grub bde chen dag pa yi zhing nas: 'od gsal gdangs lnga rig stong ye shes kyi tshom bu: shar grol bde chen tshogs kyi 'du ba la phebs nas: bdag cag mched lcam dga' ston glu gar la rol pas: 'ja' lus 'pho chen dwangs ma'i dngos grub kyang zhu'o: rang snang dag pa rnga yab dpal ri yi zhing nas:

rgyal kun 'dus zhal pad 'byung rig 'dzin gyi tshom bu: snang srid dag mnyam tshogs kyi 'du ba la phebs nas: bdag cag mched lcam dga' ston glu gar la rol pas: dgongs brgyud pha phog thob pa'i dngos grub kyang zhu'o: rnam dag bkra shis phun tshogs yid 'ong gi gnas 429)na: thabs shes gnyis med dpa' bo yab yum gyi tshom bu: 'dod yon bde stong tshogs kyi 'du ba la phebs nas: skal ldan las can rim gnyis pha phog de stsal byung: shar cha ma 'gags longs spyod zag med kyi tshogs mchod: myong grol rdzas mchog 'du ba mched lcam gyis rol nas: dga' bzhi bde ba chen po'i dngos grub kyang zhu'o: 'ja' lus zang thal sku gsum mngon gyur kyang shog cig: ces zer nas skus gar bsgyur te dbyings la thim mo: bskal pa lcags khyi lo'i zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin yab yum lhan du 'tshogs nas dus mchod kyi dga' ston la rol skabs dbyings snang mkha' 'gros dngos su gsungs pa las 'brel rtsal gyi bzhed skong du kun bzang chos nyid dbang mos bris pa'o// sku yi phyag rgyas snang srid lha skur dag /gsung gi phyag rgyas gtum mo bdur rtsir smin// thugs kyi phyag rgyas rlung sngags rig par rdzogs// dbyer med phyag rgya gsum ldan sbyong ba ni// a bu'i dgongs pa zab pa'i khyad chos lags/ a ho/ e ma ho/ zhes zer 430)skus gar mdzad nas sman phud la rol te mi snang bar yal lo/ bde ba'i rdo rje'i snang char bde chen dkar mos dngos su gsungs pa'o// dge'o// a ho/ dag pa gnyis ldan chos sku sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid// 'dren mchog bla ma dpa' bo chen po yi drung du// 'dod don ma spangs zag med thabs shes kyi rdzas mchog /longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pa'i dga' ston la rol nas// zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub kyang zhu'o// zab chos bdud rtsi 'thung ba'i skal ldan yang smon no/

a la la hoḥ rnal 'byor ma su kha badzras thabs kyi drung du phul ba dge'o// nyams snang la mkha' 'gro zhig gis 'di skad zer: dbyings mi 'gyur thig le'i drwa ba nas: mdangs sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rol par shar: rtsal 'gags med ḍā ki'i brda ru bstan: ( Dakini Secret letter here) gnas mi ring rang gnas nye ba'i sar: sngon smon gyis 'brel ba'i rasmi'i ming: rkyen dam sris brlabs pa'i btsun ma'i gzugs: rdo rje yi mdud pa rim gyis nyams: de'i rkyen gyis dpa' bo'i rtsa khams 431)'khrugs: thugs ka dag klong du 'od gsal dengs: ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bsu ma byon: bstan pa ni gzugs brnyan tsam du gyur: 'di sel thabs rdo rje'i rang gdengs phub: mi 'jigs pa'i dpa' bo go cha brtan: gnas nges med dben par sgrub tshugs zungs: phas gtad pa'i gdams pa nyams su longs: rigs can gyi bu la rim gyis spel: chos zab mo'i bstan pas phyogs kun khyab: gser ldan gyi khyu tshogs bcud la rol: g.yu phrug gi gtsug nor lag tu lon: lho ljon pa'i rtsa ba rab tu rgyas: khu byug gi sgyu rtsal dbyings nas ngoms: khyung chen rnams rim gyis gshog rtsal rdzogs: rus sbal gyi rgyal po mkha' la thim: skyon bral ba'i ku mutta tshal rgyas: rkang drug gi bung bas skyed tshal ngoms: dbyings mkha' 'gro'i brda don ma nor bar: bu rig pas dpyod la thad ka ru: brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas dpa' gding bskyed: chos brgyad kyi dug gi me tog la: sbrul nag po'i zhags pas bcings nyen gda': stag khra bo'i ngar skad ma bsgrags na: rim bzhin du dben par 432)btsan sa zungs: dus snyigs ma'i mi la blo gtad med: rang pha bu yin kyang dgra ltar mthong: chos brgyud pa gcig kyang dam tshig med: chos brgyad kyi don gnyer grub thob mang: tshul 'chos kyi zog po mgo bskor ni: dge slong dang btsun pa'i tshul 'dzin pa: skal dman kun log pa'i lam du khrid:

'brel tshad kun ngan song gnas su skye: dpal padma mngags pa'i pho nya yis: gser ra gan ma nor rigs pas dpyod: 'dis don gnyis yid bzhin lhun grub nas: drug bcu'i dus dpal ri'i pho brang 'god: dbyings mkha' 'gro'i brda don i thi rgya: zhes pa 'di yang rmi lam 'khrul snang la brten nas bde ba'i rdo rjes bris pa'o// he he// shar nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor rgyan du mdzes: byang phag nag gi ngur sgras sde gsum bcom: stag 'dzin pa'i mi dpon lnga lam 'grims: lho 'bras ldan gyi bstan pa re zhig tu: bdud mi ru brdzu bas bsgyur yang srid: ma hā kā la'i bzlog brgyur mdos la brtson: mgon padma'i sprul pas skyobs par nges: de rigs pas dpyod la gzab gal che: zhes zer yal/ 433)bde ba'i rdo rjes so// dge'o// rang mdun gyi nam mkha'i dbyings klong du: zer thag gi 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro: 'od mthing gsal chos 'byung dga' 'khyil dbus: ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dkar gsal mdzes: spyi gtsug tu rigs bdag snang mtha' yas: g.yas 'jam dpal dmar po ral gri 'dzin: g.yon gaṅga'i lha mo rnga yab 'dzin: 'ja' 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i klong dkyil du: sku snang la rang bzhin med par mthong: bdag mos gus kyis gsol ba 'di ltar btab: bdag gis tshe rabs sngon nas bsgrubs pa'i lha: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las dpal: bcom ldan yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'phel ma: sku mdog dkar mo ston zla'i dpal nas mdzes: dri bral pad dkar zla ba'i gdan steng du: zla ba'i rgyab yol skyil krung bcas mdzad ma: sku yi 'od kyis 'jigs pa ma lus sel: mchog sbyin lha mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: zhal gyi padma'i 'dab phreng las 'khrungs pa'i: tshangs dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i chos sgra sgrog: tā ra gnyis brjod 434)srid zhi dbang bsgyur mdzad: rgyal ba'i sras kyis rab tu bstod cing 'dud: shes rab dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod:

ma lus pha rol phyin mdzad rgyal ba'i yum: rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje'i thugs gsang 'dzin: sna tshogs thabs kyis mdzad pa cir yang ston: gnas gsum ḍā ki'i gtso mo khyod la bstod: padma'i rigs 'chang sor rtogs ye shes te: gsung gi rdo rje khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: byang chub sems dpa' sras kyi thu bo 'dzin: smra ba'i seng ge khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: ngag gi dbang phyug shes rab tshul 'chang ba: gaṅga'i lha mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces gsol ba btab ma thag tu sku mi snang bar gsung gi gdangs las: oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā: yang dag srog gi snying po 'di: dus kun brjod pa'i bsod nams kyis: stobs bcu mthar son sa bcu thob: tām̐ yig rlung sems dbyer med par: rtsa gnas yi ge'i sprin du bstim: gdos bcas mi snang dbyings su thim: kun tu 'od kyi sa la phyin: thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob: a haṃḥ zhes rang gi gnas bzhir 'od kyi rnam par gtso 'khor thams cad thim pas bde stong dbyer mi phyed pa'i ngang du dar cig 435)gnas so: bde ba'i rdo rje'i snang nyams so: dge'o// mkha' 'gro kun gsal mas/ kyai kyai/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi ma la// phas bu la gdams pa'i zab chos ni// ma ḍā ki'i thugs bcud khyad du 'phags// de gser dang rang gan ma nor na// bu don gnyis nor bu lag tu lon/ de dus su mi ring nye ba'i gnas// smon log gi dam sri mi ru brdzu// bar chad kyi rlung nag 'tshub ma ldang*// rdo rje yi mdud pa g.ya' yis nyams// rkyen mkha' 'gro 'khu zhing mi 'dod 'byung*// thugs dgongs pa 'od gsal dbyings su bsdu// tshul rig pas dpyod la dpa' gding bskyed// 'khor 'das kyi chos kun sgyu ma'i ngang*// legs nyes kun 'od gsal rig pa'i rtsal// gnod byed kyi lha 'dre tshar bcad nas// bu'i rang tshugs zungs la rang mdangs skyongs// brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa thad ka ru// rtsal cho 'phrul sna tshogs dbyings su gtor// rkyen snang ba rang grol gdams pa longs// pha mtsho skyes rdo rjes gdams pa'i chos// mdangs rma bya'i dug gis ma bcos par// ma mkha' 'gros lung

436)bstan ji bzhin du/ khyod rig pas dpyod la rim bzhin brtson// des bar chad g.yul las rgyal nas kyang*/ chos smin grol gyi mdzad pa mthar phyin nges/ sa ma ya/ zhes zer mi snang bar yal/ su kha badzras so// phyi yi 'khrul zhig tshogs drug der 'dzin bral: yid shes kyi gnyen pos ma bslad grol: nang 'khrul zhig bskyed pa a 'thas bral: snang rtog kun sgyu ma'i lha skur grol: gsang ba 'khrul zhig ye gzhi ka nas dag: ngo bo ye shes lu gu brgyud du grol: 'khrul yang 'khrul te chos dbyings ngang du 'khrul: zhig kyang zhig ste chos dbyings klong du zhig: chos dbyings ngang las g.yo med chos kun grol: 'khrul zhig nga ni bi ma mi tra yin: a phaṭa: phyi yi rnal 'byor byang chub sems kyi rtsal: snod bcud lha yi phyag rgyar nyams su longs: nang gi rnal 'byor zung 'jug bde ba'i sku: las kyi phyag rgyar sbyor sgrol nyams su longs: gsang ba'i rnal 'byor gnyis med ye shes don: rtsa bral rdo rje snying po nyams su longs: rnal 'byor nga ni bi ma mi tra 437)yin: a phaṭa: su kha badzra gyis so// ḍā ki mi yi zol 'chang ba// rigs ldan rnal 'byor dbang mo nyon// smon log dam sri'i phrag dog gis// dmod ngan byad phur thogs pa la// yang bzlog rdo rje pha lam ni/ khyed kyi dpa' bo'i go bgos na// bzlog cing bsgyur bar gdon mi za// padmas mngags pa'i pho nya ni// ye shes rtsal snang mngon shes kyis// dus gsum phan bde rang la rag /gzhan gyis 'khrul gtam rdzun gyis bslu// smin grol dkyil 'khor zhal phye dus// nyams pa rnams dang bsre mi rung*// bsres na mi 'dod sna 'dren byed// rig pas dpyod la gzab gal che// dus dang dus su brda don gsal// go bar gyis shig rigs ldan ma/ zhes pa'ang tshogs gral red snyam pa zhig tu yud tsam lhag mkha' 'gro bde ba'i go chas gdams pa'o// sprang mo'i 'khrul nyams so//

༄/ āḥ rnam thar gsum ldan stong pa nyid// rang bzhin ma 'gags lhun grub rtsal// thugs rje sgyu 'phrul rol pa las// rang rig hrīḥ 438) yig yongs gyur pas// bde chen padma dbang gi lha// rnam kun mchog ldan btsun mo ni// 'od dmar rdo rje rtse gsum gyur// rdo rje'i lte bar hrīḥdamar mthar// snying po 'bru brgyad g.yon du 'khor// g.yas phyogs rtse mo'i khong gseng nas// yi ge oṃ dkar yongs gyur pas// rdo rje rnal 'byor dkar gsal mdzes/ zhal gcig spyan gsum dbyings su gzigs// dbu skra sil ma rgyab tu 'phyangs// dar dang rin chen dbu rgyan mdzes// phyag gnyis g.yas pas cang te'u 'khrol// g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar stob// sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*// dar dpyangs rin chen sna chogs brgyan// utpal dmar po'i do shal 'phyangs// zhabs gnyis gar stabs pad zlar bzhugs// g.yon gyi rtse mo'i khong gseng nas// āḥyig dmar po yongs gyur pas// mkha' spyod dbang mo dmar gsal mdzes// zhal gcig spyan gsum dbyings su gzigs// dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes// thod skam lnga yi rtse bran can// phyag g.yas gri gug thur du 'phyar// g.yon pas thod khrag zhal 439)gsol tshul// g.yon phyogs phrag g.yon steng nas 'dzin// mchan khung kha ṭwām̐ ga 'chang zhing*// sku la rus rgyan phyag rgya lnga yis spras// thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal dang*// dar dpyangs rin chen sna tshogs 'phyangs// ye shes lnga ldan me dpung klong*// zhabs gnyis g.yas bskyang g.yon bskum zhing*// gar stabs bam ro sad nyir bzhugs// dbus kyi rtse mo'i khong gseng nas// hūm̐ yig mthing ga yongs gyur pas// bde chen rdo rje phag mo ni// mthing gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// gri thod 'dzin cing spyan gsum ldan// dbu skra kham ser gyen du 'khyil// dbu gtsug phag zhal ngur sgra sgrog

/thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ khro mo'i chas kun rab tu rdzogs// gzig sham smad dkris kha ṭwām̐ 'chang*// zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs shing*// bam ro dmar ser snying gar brdzis// thugs klong dpa' bo rta mgrin dmar// phyag gnyis gri thod thugs kar 'dzin// dpal dang dur khrod chas kun rdzogs/ 440)/spyi gtsug rta mog ljang khur 'tsher// zhabs gnyis pad nyi bam steng brdzis// ye shes me phung 'khyil ba'i klong*// gar dgu rngams brjid rol pas bzhugs// lha tshogs de dag gnas gsum las// rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bo 'bru gsum dang*// rang rang thugs srog sa bon yig 'bru las// 'od 'phros rgyal kun mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus// mar 'phros 'gro ba'i sgrib sbyangs bde la bkod// tshe bsod dpal 'byor 'dod dgu thams cad bsdus// rang rang srog gi sa bon nyid la bstim// sku yi dbyibs brgyud gsang ba'i padma nas// 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan rnam pa ru// rdo rje'i lte ba'i sngags phreng nyid la thim// phyi snod 'od dmar rnam pa'i gzhal yas khang*// nang bcud der 'dzin bral ba lha'i phyag rgya// dran rtog 'od gsal gnyug ma rtsa bral klong*// lus ni dur khrod mi ro lta bur song*// 'od dmar rnam pa gdos bcas lus mi snang*// ngag ni lkugs pa ji bzhin smra brjod bral// grags stong skye med sngags sgras snang yul khyab// sems ni rtog med khong snying med dang mtshungs// yul med zang thal gtad med rgya yan du// yid dpyod 441)blo bral khyab brdal nam mkha' che// dgag sgrub re dogs med ba'i zang thal lo// yid shes 'dzin pas bzung yang bcos med par// lung ma bstan gyi 'khrul nyams de ltar shar// thun dang thun mtshams med par lkog 'gyur ro// sgrub pa'i lha dang sngags dang sgrub pa po// bsgrub dang 'grub par bya ba'i yul rnams kun// 'od gsal rig stong spros bral klong chen mkha'// chu las chu bur rdol ba ji bzhin mthong*// de dag dngos po mtshan ma can yin kyang*// lung ma bstan gyi dbang gis dngos med snang*// 'khrul nyams 'di las sel thabs man ngag zhig
/thabs grogs yid bzhin nor bus bstsal du gsol/ ces su kha badzra gyis phul ba'o// 442)
